title: bizplan-overhaul ultragoal
vision: Rename ralplan → bizplan and make bizplan the only planning surface in Bizar. Ship three planning tiers (light / standard / heavy) selected by request shape, persist every run into .ok/plans/pln-*.json with PRD cross-reference and auto-spawn the executor task in .ok/tasks/. Hard-rename the SDK RalplanHandoff contract to BizplanHandoff. Delete /ralplan and /plan. Wire Mike's office-manager routing so non-trivial requests default to bizplan. Ship one recorded end-to-end loop (plan → task → evidence → close) as the integration test. Migration of run tracking to OpenKan completed 2026-09-07: state now lives at .ok/prds/prd-bizplan-overhaul.json, .ok/plans/pln-bizplan-overhaul.json, and .ok/tasks/tsk-*.json; legacy docs/specs/ultragoal/ultragoal-bizplan-overhaul.jsonl preserved as historical artifact.

goals.text: Stream A — sdk-bizplan-contract, sdk-bizplan-persistence, slash-bizplan-commands (owned by todd)
Stream B — skill-bizplan-tiering, office-manager-routing, mcp-tool-rename, sdk-goal-cli, arch-tests-cleanup (owned by karen)
Stream C — e2e-loop-evidence (serial after A+B merged; integration gate)
Postscript — cli-flag-handling-fix, sdk-version-sync (orchestrator; tracks f4662857 + ab252403)
Migration to OpenKan — rehydrate run tracking as prd-bizplan-overhaul + pln-bizplan-overhaul + 11 tsk-* tasks (this postscript)

nonGoals: No multi-PRD scope creep. Only PRD-level cross-reference is added; PRD authoring/editing stays on the existing ok prd surface.
No new daemon, no new note vault, no new web control plane. Bizplan state is .ok/plans/pln-*.json only.
No new model routing. Bizplan's tier selection is purely request-shape driven; the existing static haiku|sonnet|opus|fable alias map still drives dispatch.
No automated cut of a 10.27.0 release.
No silent deletion of ralplan historical references in feature_list.legacy.json or docs/historical/.

milestones.title: Stream B (skill + agents + mcp + arch-tests + goal-cli) merged
Postscript fixes (cli flag handling + sdk version sync) merged
Run tracking migrated to OpenKan (prd-bizplan-overhaul + pln-bizplan-overhaul + tsk-*)

risks.text: Hidden references to RalplanHandoff in MCP client code or external integrations break on rename (likelihood: medium, impact: medium)
risks.mitigation: check-arch + grep -rn RalplanHandoff|ralplan gate before declaring done.

risks.text: .ok/plans/ schema drift between bizplan-standard and bizplan-heavy (likelihood: medium, impact: medium)
risks.mitigation: Single BizplanPlan interface with optional lanes[] and worktreeStrategy.

risks.text: Operator routing pivot silently keeps /ralplan path because of stale examples (likelihood: medium, impact: low)
risks.mitigation: Lint test that fails if office-manager.md mentions ralplan outside historical footnote.

risks.text: OpenKan migration duplicates state with legacy ledger (likelihood: low, impact: low)
risks.mitigation: Mark legacy ledger as historical artifact; canonical state at .ok/
